description: Fetch one Account/Subscription/Invoice/Payment/Product object by type + id. Requires type and id.
embedding_description: Retrieve a single Zuora billing object's fields by its object type (Account, Subscription, Invoice, Payment, or Product) and id. Requires type and id.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with object: a mapping of field names to values.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show the requested fields; object data reflects sensitive billing/financial content (data_sensitivity 0.5) — surface for downstream use but never treat as public.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Fetch one Zuora object by type and id.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: zuora.invalid_params: missing or unsupported type, or missing id. zuora.object_not_found: no object with that id exists for that type. zuora.auth_failed: the OAuth client credentials were rejected.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: zuora.object_not_found: verify the id and type are correct, e.g. via data_query. zuora.invalid_params: type must be one of Account, Subscription, Invoice, Payment, Product.
